name: 27131-loradecode-gptoss20b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder, mxfp4 expert weights, 24 layers, 32 experts, 4 active per token, hidden size 2880; one resident LoRA adapter of rank 8, alpha 16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 80 requests with a 900 s safety cap; the concurrency equals the engine's --max-num-seqs 8, so all eight streams are admitted.
workload: ShareGPT V3 conversational prompts, single turn, 80 rows shipped as configs/data/sharegpt-v3-gptoss-80.jsonl (GuideLLM json_file, request_format plain), 19708 prompt and 16469 completion tokens. Every request is routed to the adapter; temperature is 0.0 and ignore_eos fixes each row's output length.
purpose: A fine-tuned 20-billion-parameter chat assistant serving eight concurrent conversation streams through one LoRA adapter on a single GPU.
launch:
# These are AsyncEngineArgs fields: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# `--served-model-name` and `--lora-modules` are API-server frontend flags and are NOT fields
# here; the adapter is declared per request, in scenario.json's `spec.backend.lora_request`.

model: openai/gpt-oss-20b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
trust-remote-code: true
enable-lora: true
max-loras: 1
max-lora-rank: 64                    # slot size; deliberately above the adapter's own rank of 8
max-num-seqs: 8
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.95
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096
